description: This file defines functions for parsing feature flags and experiment toggles from environment variables in a React frontend project. It includes utilities to interpret feature flags provided as CSV or JSON strings, check if experiments are enabled, and retrieve individual feature flags.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags(raw)
methods.description: Parses feature flags from a string input, supporting CSV format or JSON object format, returning an object with flag names as keys and booleans as values.

methods.name: getExperimentsEnabled()
methods.description: Checks the environment variable REACT_APP_EXPERIMENTS_ENABLED and returns true if it indicates experiments are enabled.

methods.name: getFeatureFlag(name)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific feature flag's boolean value based on its name from the environment variables.
